rules.title: Insecure NULL Encryption Cipher Suite Negotiated
rules.description: Negotiated cipher suite provides zero payload encryption.
rules.remediation: Disable all NULL cipher suites across all endpoints.

rules.title: Broken RC4 Stream Cipher Negotiated
rules.description: Negotiated cipher suite uses the broken RC4 stream cipher prohibited by RFC 7465.
rules.remediation: Disable RC4 cipher suites across all endpoints.

rules.title: Vulnerable 64-bit Block Cipher (3DES / Triple-DES)
rules.description: 64-bit block ciphers are susceptible to SWEET32 collision attacks.
rules.remediation: Replace 3DES with AES-128-GCM, AES-256-GCM, or ChaCha20-Poly1305.

rules.title: CBC-Mode Cipher Suite in TLS 1.2
rules.description: CBC mode ciphers in TLS 1.2 are susceptible to padding oracle attacks.
rules.remediation: Migrate to AEAD ciphers (AES-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305).

rules.title: Approved AEAD Cipher Suite Negotiated
rules.description: Negotiated cipher suite complies with NIST SP 800-52r2 approved specifications.
rules.remediation: Maintain approved AEAD cipher suite policy.

rules.title: Unrecognized or Unverified Cipher Suite Negotiated
rules.description: Negotiated cipher suite is not recognized or not on the approved cipher baseline.
rules.remediation: Review negotiated cipher suite and ensure server prioritizes approved AEAD ciphers.

rules.title: Static RSA Key Exchange (Missing Forward Secrecy)
rules.description: Static RSA key transport does not provide Perfect Forward Secrecy (PFS).
rules.remediation: Configure ephemeral Diffie-Hellman (ECDHE or DHE) key exchange.

rules.title: Weak Diffie-Hellman Modulus (< 2048 bits)
rules.description: Finite Field DH modulus length is under 2048 bits (vulnerable to Logjam).
rules.remediation: Deploy custom Diffie-Hellman parameters >= 2048 bits or migrate to ECDHE.
